column1: # The rows tools/ops/attribution_job.sh times and profiles by default (AT_ROWS_FILE names another file of this form).
# One row per line, tab or space separated: race id, forced phase, profiled arm, then optional fields:
#   name=<row>                the row's directory name (default: the race's lane)
#   timing=<run>|<run>...     the timing runs, each an own-arm list in order (a,b) or `planned` (default: planned)
#   kernels                   part C (the distance kernels under ncu) applies
# Phase: `fit`, `infer/<batch>`. Arm: the own arm the profile times (`ours` unless the race plans another);
# only tree races take an own-arm list (MOJOLEARN_BENCH_OWN_ARMS).
# the prebinned arm ALONE, then both arms in each order: the arm-order test
